For every sequence term \\(x\\), the set \\(\\sigma(x)\\) is good.","status_as_written":"established","repair_distance":"symbol","explanation":"The numerical objection is correct: after 15 and 18, 20 is admissible and is the next term, while 22 is coprime to 15. This error occurs only in a supplementary example. The preceding induction proves for every term that deleting primes greater than A preserves goodness, and equation (3) then proves membership depends only on primes at most A. Replacing “22” with “20” repairs the example."}
